scope: New 5KB staging template only; no formal architecture rereview.

checks.unbound_gate: FINAL_ENTRYPOINTS=None is rejected before any Git read or fetch; exact two entrypoint names and positive byte lengths/SHA256 formats are required. This was checked statically; prior smoke was not rerun.
checks.publication_identity: Requires exact 40-hex publication, AM ancestry, executed stager bytes equal to that publication, then each entrypoint payload equal to its fixed fingerprint.
checks.copy_scope: Only same-publication run_geometry.py under ROOT and install_geometry_source.py under INSTALL_ROOT, each in published-entrypoints; writes one staging receipt under ROOT. No checkout, canonical Lean source installation, import of the runner, or Lean execution.
checks.copy_behavior: Existing files must have identical bytes; differing files are rejected. New files use O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW and file/directory fsync. Destination paths must resolve without symlinks.
checks.git_state: Exact byte fingerprints of HEAD, porcelain status, worktree diff and index diff must match before/after before a success receipt is written. Fetch adds the required publication objects, with no tags or FETCH_HEAD write; four-state preservation is asserted on successful completion.
checks.outcome_boundary: Any caught exception produces explicit staging HOLD with no acceptance claim. Staging success states canonical_source_installed=false, normal_or_kernel_commands_executed=0, new_owner_accepted=false, whole_P1_5_complete=false.
checks.failure_partial_copy: If a later staging check fails, an earlier exact copied entrypoint can remain; the process does not emit success and a subsequent identical copy is idempotent. No owner or Lean source is created.

execution_boundary.next_required_review: After the actual successful v3 probe and final runner INPUTS are bound, review only FINAL_ENTRYPOINTS exact final fingerprint delta before publishing/running the stager.
